findings.title: Marimo: Pre-Auth Remote Code Execution via Terminal WebSocket Authentication Bypass (GHSA-2679-6mx9-h9xc)
findings.summary_md: The GitHub advisory published on April 8, 2026, documents CVE-2026-39987, a critical pre-auth remote code execution vulnerability in marimo versions through 0.20.4. The terminal WebSocket endpoint /terminal/ws skips the validate_auth() check that other endpoints enforce, allowing any unauthenticated client to open a full interactive PTY shell. The fix was released in marimo 0.23.0 via PR #9098. The advisory includes a proof-of-concept script and notes that commands run as root in default Docker deployments.

findings.title: Marimo OSS Python Notebook RCE: From Disclosure to Exploitation in Under 10 Hours
findings.summary_md: Sysdig Threat Research Team reported on April 9, 2026, that exploitation of CVE-2026-39987 began 9 hours and 41 minutes after the advisory was published. The attacker connected to the /terminal/ws endpoint without authentication, validated execution with a scripted PoC, then manually explored the filesystem, read .env files, and attempted to retrieve SSH private keys. No public proof-of-concept existed at the time of the first observed exploitation attempts. The blog details the attacker timeline from 07:31 to 09:04 UTC on April 9 and confirms the complete credential-theft chain occurred in under three minutes.

findings.title: CVE-2026-39987 Detail - NVD
findings.summary_md: The National Vulnerability Database entry published April 9, 2026, assigns CVSS v4.0 score 9.3 (Critical) to CVE-2026-39987. It confirms the vulnerability affects marimo versions prior to 0.23.0, describes the missing authentication on the /terminal/ws WebSocket endpoint, and lists the weakness as CWE-306 (Missing Authentication for Critical Function). EPSS is listed at 99.564 percent, placing the flaw at the 100th percentile for exploitation probability within 30 days.

findings.title: CVE-2026-39987 — Marimo Pre-Auth RCE — SentinelOne Vulnerability Database
findings.summary_md: SentinelOne's vulnerability database entry from April 9, 2026, classifies CVE-2026-39987 as a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in the marimo Python notebook. It notes the affected endpoint /terminal/ws allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain an interactive shell, and confirms versions through 0.20.4 are vulnerable with 0.23.0 as the patched release.
